press.quote: The penalty came in the 21st minute: Lamine Yamal went down in the box after a challenge from Villarreal forward Tani Oluwaseyi. Archivo VAR, a site that rates refereeing, said the penalty was correct, and rated the referee 2.5 out of 10 for the match.

The TV broadcast did not show the incident.

key_choices.text: Flick decided Barcelona would no longer have a fixed starting XI ahead of a run of five matches in 15 days that included PSG and El Clásico, as reported by Sport.
For the Champions League match against Aston Villa, Flick turned to the academy amid several absences, which opened the door for four youth-team players to join the first-team squad.
For the Villarreal match, Flick started Frenkie de Jong at centre-back and Eric Garcia at right-back. Barcelona had to reshape their defence because of injuries.
Flick said Karim Adeyemi started against Villarreal because Anthony had played two matches for his national team, while Karim trained extremely well and deserved the chance.
After the defeats by Real Madrid and Paris Saint-Germain, Flick said he had complete faith in Barcelona and the playing style he is trying to establish.

links.text: Flick's Bayern won the 2020 treble, which included an 8-2 thrashing of Barcelona in the Champions League quarter-finals.

ESPN reported in 2021 that Laporta had sounded out Flick's availability while he was still at Bayern. Flick had already committed to the Germany job. Laporta stayed a fan, and talks with Flick's camp were constant after Xavi said in January 2024 that he would step down.

teams.appointed: 1 June 2026, when Villarreal officially confirmed him as head coach. He signed a three-year contract running to June 2029. He was presented the following Tuesday at the Estadio de la Cerámica.
teams.replaced_reason: Marcelino left the club at the end of the 2025-26 season even though he had led Villarreal to third in La Liga and Champions League qualification. The club did not officially detail the reasons for the separation.

institution_quote.speaker: Fernando Roig, Villarreal president (at Pérez's presentation, describing the signing; partial quote in Spanish)

coach_promise.quote: We cannot promise results, but I strongly identify with family values, ambition, sacrifice and hard work.

reviews.headline: Claves de la victoria del Barcelona vs Villarreal en LaLiga
reviews.quote: Si bien el neerlandés se ha desempeñado en dicha posición, no la domina y ante atacantes tan rápidos como los del Villarreal quedó exhibido.
reviews.quote_en: Although the Dutchman has played in that position, he has not mastered it, and against attackers as quick as Villarreal's he was exposed.
reviews.point: The writer says Flick took a big risk by starting Frenkie de Jong at centre-back and underestimated Villarreal, whose pace exposed him early. Barcelona's pressure and Pedri's influence in the second half then turned the game.

reviews.headline: Barcelona Player Ratings vs. Villarreal: Inspired Comeback Creates Buffer at La Liga Summit
reviews.quote: Unsurprisingly, Yamal was the chief architect, dazzling yellow jerseys with his electric feet and supreme precision, and he more than made up for his penalty miss.
reviews.point: The piece says Barcelona's defending in the opening minutes was abysmal, but their attacking play saved them. It names Lamine Yamal as the main creator and says he made up for his missed penalty, with Pedri also elegant in midfield. SI is not on your outlet list, so use it only if you accept it as being of the same standing.

Two Goals in 7 Minutes: What Went Wrong at Barça?
Barça vs Villarreal: De Jong at Centre-Back
script.description:
Frenkie de Jong starts at centre-back, and Barça are 0-2 down inside 7 minutes. We follow the story through Flick's reshaped defence, Pérez's plan and Pedri's night, then ask what the numbers say about whether Barça were really beaten.

Quotes and reports come from FC Barcelona's official site, CGTN, Comuniate, ESPN, ESPN Deportes and Sports Illustrated. Data: football-data.org + FotMob.

shots.text: Hansi Flick has a problem. Injuries have hit his defence, so Frenkie de Jong, a midfielder, will start at centre-back, with Eric García at right-back.

Spotify Camp Nou, Barcelona. Barça lead La Liga after this round, with 12 wins in 13 games, and Flick has promised attacking football. Then, at minute 5, Villarreal score. At minute 7, they score again.
Two goals in 7 minutes. What went wrong at the back, and was Barça already beaten?

shots.text: Flick arrived in May 2024 to replace Xavi. At his presentation, he promised "all possession and really attacking football."
Our reading: that promise leans on the back line. Tonight that line has a midfielder at its centre, Frenkie de Jong, with Eric García at right-back. If it cracks, the whole idea is exposed.
Ahead of them, Lamine Yamal, the most valuable starter on the pitch at 221 million euros. He is the one asked to make that risk pay.

And Fermín López, who gave the ball away for the first goal: 4 goals in his last 4 games, one of them tonight, in 68 minutes on the pitch.

shots.text: Expected goals, or xG, is learned from past shots: distance, angle, foot or head. It says how often a chance like it is scored.
Villarreal's two goals were worth 0.04 and 0.06 xG. Almost nothing. Barça's penalty at minute 23 was worth 0.79, and it hit the post.
Over the night, Barça finish on 3.29 xG to Villarreal's 0.17. 93 percent of it came through the centre, and many of those shots were blocked.
Replay these chances 20,000 times, and Barça win 97 in 100. So the 0-2 half did lie. Barça's chances were not the problem. Luck and finishing were.

shots.text: So, was De Jong the weak point? One report says he was caught out of position for the second goal, leaving Eric García to chase Oluwaseyi. Pedri calls him "extraordinary".
The numbers lean his way: 104 of 110 passes, 7 recoveries, 3 of 3 ground duels won, never dribbled past. They cannot show where he stood when that pass was played.
Barça were unlucky at one end, shaky at the other, and still won 3-2.
Two questions for you. Was De Jong at centre-back a risk worth taking? And was Fermín's red card fair? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for the next match.

shorts.title: Pedri's 9.0: the midfielder who ran Camp Nou

shots.text: Pedri finished with a 9.0 rating, the highest of anyone on the pitch.
He created 6 chances, gave 1 assist and completed 81 of 92 passes.
15 of those passes went into the final third. He also won 7 of his 8 duels.
He had 107 touches and 10 recoveries, his most in his last 6 games.
The numbers cannot show how he moved without the ball. Does a 9.0 sound fair to you? Full story on the channel.

shorts.title: 10 corners to 0: how Barça cracked Villarreal

shots.text: Barça won 10 corners. Villarreal won none.
Villarreal's coach wanted a high press. With 30% of the ball, they ended up defending their own box.
At minute 53, a corner gave Marc Bernal a header, and it went wide. At minute 57, another corner gave Gerard Martín a header, and it went in.
Four minutes later, Fermín López scored too. The wall had a crack, and Barça kept pushing on it.

One caution: 0.79 of the 1.65 set-piece xG was the penalty Yamal hit against the post. So dead balls opened the door, and volume finished the job. Was it the corners or the pressure that won it? Full story on the channel.
